tool.name: Merge.otus
tool.description: Merge OTUs that share the same taxonomy

param.name: label
param.label: label - select OTU distance labels
param.help: all labels are used if none are selected

param.label: taxlevel - taxonomy level used to merge the OTUs
param.help: If not provided mothur uses the deepest level of the consensus taxonomy

tool.help:
@MOTHUR_OVERVIEW@
**Command Documentation**
The merge.otus_ command combines the OTUs of a shared_, list_ or relabund_ file that share the same consensus taxonomy, i.e. it reduces the OTU table to the taxonomic level you are interested in. The taxonomy is provided with a consensus taxonomy file, as generated by classify.otu_. The taxlevel_ parameter selects the taxonomic level used for the merge (the deepest level of the taxonomy is the default).
A new consensus taxonomy for the merged OTUs and the merged OTU table are written, the latter in the format of the input table.
